content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often restrict access to digital creators in emerging markets, forcing them to sell their products at a loss. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from these restrictions and keep their hard-earned profits. This infrastructure uses Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments to create a decentralized payment and delivery pipeline that's resilient to platform failures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to sign up for a Cloudflare account, create a GitHub Pages site, and set up a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build and deploy your stack. The kit is available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages site. You'll also need to set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will allow you to deliver your ebooks and templates directly to customers without relying on a platform like Gumroad or Payhip.
Building a sovereign digital commerce stack allows you to keep 99.5% of your revenue instead of giving 10% to a platform like Gumroad.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live. Simply upload your ebooks and templates to your Cloudflare Pages site, and configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment and fire a webhook to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will trigger automated delivery of the product to the customer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This can be done by adding more Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script functions, or by upgrading to a more powerful plan on Cloudflare. You can also use the Complete Builder Kit to create more templates and blueprints, and to customize your stack to meet the needs of your growing business.

The most important thing to remember when building a sovereign digital commerce stack is that you own everything after deployment. This means that you have complete control over your payment and delivery pipeline, and that you can customize your stack to meet the needs of your business without relying on a platform like Gumroad or Payhip. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies and deliver your products directly to customers without relying on a platform.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a GitHub Pages site. Set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages site. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit and download the templates and blueprints. Set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments. Upload your ebooks and templates to your Cloudflare Pages site. Go live and start processing transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Cloudflare Pages site?

To integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and add a payment button to your site. You can then configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments and set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Can I use a different payment processor instead of NOWPayments?

While it's technically possible to use a different payment processor, NOWPayments is specifically designed to work with Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages, making it the best choice for building a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

To set up automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you'll need to create a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script function that triggers when a payment is received. This function can then deliver the product to the customer without relying on a platform like Gumroad or Payhip.
Can I sell digital products that require shipping?
While NOWPayments is designed for digital products, you can still use it to sell physical products that require shipping by integrating it with a shipping provider like ShipStation or ShipBob.
How do I scale my infrastructure as my business grows?

To scale your infrastructure, you can add more Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script functions, or upgrade to a more powerful plan on Cloudflare. You can also use the Complete Builder Kit to create more templates and blueprints, and to customize your stack to meet the needs of your growing business.
By owning your own infrastructure, you can customize your stack to meet the needs of your business without relying on a platform like Gumroad or Payhip.
